commentary_segments.text: Another CMFB amplifier is shown here. It now closes the feedback loop to the top current source. This is indeed good! Again, the output voltages are measured. The differential signals are cancelled out and the CMFB loop is closed by means of an amplifier. Now transistors M1 and M2 are common to both amplifiers. They function as a (differential) amplifier for differential signals, but as cascodes for the common-mode signals. In order to gain somewhat more insight in this CMFB amplifier it is sketched separately in the next slide.
